<subject>Electronic Transactions Agreement - revised</subject>
<body>
As you know, the ETA has to address AuroraTel one-to-many with Maple & Crown and NexusCom one-to-many with Maple & Crown.  We also need a separate AuroraTel GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown and Separate NexusCom GTC one-to-many with Maple & Crown.  We also need a single PulseNet application that addresses ApexLink, both one-to-many.

As soon as these drafts are complete, I would like to read them!

Thanks.

Lee Mills
Associate
Maple & Crown Telecom Inc.
403-999-1234
</body>
<quoted>
---------------------- Forwarded by Lee Mills on 2024-07-10 11:33 AM ---------------------------
From: Travis McCullough@maplecrown.ca on 2024-07-09 08:33 PM
To: Lee Mills, Nicholas Porter, John Cummings, Bradley Miller, Douglas Dixon, Harry M Collins, Sandra Wood
cc:  
Subject: Electronic Transactions Agreement - revised

Attached is a revised version of the ETA omitting the distinction between transactions on NexusCom and transactions on AuroraTel.   If Maple & Crown is the only party permitted to post product on NexusCom, there is no need for the special rules that we drafted for what was previously a "many-to-many" matching site. However, we will need to develop a different set of GTCs for transactions that Maple & Crown closes on NexusCom, since the products transacted on NexusCom are not likely to be the type that lend themselves to Maple & Crown's standard GTCs.
